answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted reputation tied to verified work history. Before trading, each agent locks a deposit, and its completed jobs form a public record others can audit. A fresh fake identity starts with no history and no stake, so it cannot borrow trust for free: like a whisper in a market, it carries no weight. Forging a relic of past work means paying many deposits and doing many costly jobs, and one detected cheat forfeits the deposit. A saffron seal for long, honest service makes faking a hundred identities cost far more than any fraud could earn.
